title: Coventry and Warwickshire heritage visual evidence

items.comment: The provenance-reviewed familiar name St Mary's Guildhall must retrieve the official St Mary's Hall record without replacing its source title or hiding the bounded result count.
checks: The active query, result count and official source title remain visible together.
A familiar discovery name never replaces the canonical Historic England title.
Search, facets and view controls remain readable without horizontal clipping at 1440 by 1000 pixels.
The empty/unmatched and spelling-tolerance notices reserve space without obscuring results.

items.comment: The selected St Mary's Hall route must connect the familiar-name result to additive YAML-LD identity and assertion boundaries in one beginner-readable detail experience.
checks: The selected record retains its official title and NHLE identifier.
The familiar-name result retains the official source title while the semantic panel is open.
YAML-LD identity and assertion scope are presented in plain language rather than only as raw JSON.
Long identifiers and source links wrap without covering controls or adjacent evidence.
